title: Integration tests and test harness infrastructure
description:
Implement integration tests (in-process and remote round-trip) and the test harness
infrastructure from the test harness doc.

Sections: 14 (Testing), test harness doc sections 1-3, 7-9, 11-17

Key deliverables:
- Test infrastructure:
  - internal/agent/agenttest/test_stack.go — AgentTestStack wiring AgentLoopService +
    AgentRPCServer + AgentServiceClient in-process with MockEventPublisher
  - Extend MockAgentDriver with ToolCallScript, PanicOnStart for fault injection
- Property-based tests (from test harness §3):
  - P1: State machine validity
  - P2: Codec round-trip (extend from task 1)
  - P3: ResumeSession validation
  - P4: Event ordering
  - P5: EventPublisher consistency
  - P6: Cross-agent resume round-trip
- Integration tests:
  - In-process AgentLoopService round-trip (multi-turn, steer, follow-up, resume, fork)
  - Remote round-trip via loopback ConnectRPC (same scenarios, verify event fidelity)
  - Session forking stress test (FK1-FK2: fork 20 sessions, fork under load)
  - Cross-agent resume round-trip tests (CR1-CR3)
  - Event stream fidelity (EF1-EF4: no drops, terminal guarantees, ordering)
  - Dual-view streaming tests (DV1-DV2)
  - Graceful shutdown tests (GS1-GS3)
  - Fault injection tests (FI1-FI5)
- Benchmarks (B1-B6): session creation, event throughput, RPC overhead, resume, codec, lookup
- Stress/soak tests (ST1-ST3)
- Security tests (SEC1-SEC3)

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/18-agent-loop-rpc.md §14
- Test harness: docs/plans/18-agent-loop-rpc-test-harness.md (all sections)
- Depends on: aiag-rmv.3 (RPC transport layer)
